show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/nfuYSF
show.description: Satyamev Singh, an undefeated lawyer who believes in the justice system, finds his world shattered when the criminal he defends destroys his own family. Now torn between his duty and personal pain, he must decide whether to trust the law or seek justice on his own.
